title: Metadata
description: Metadata describing pipeline execution context, versioning, and timing for a full risk analysis run.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of pipeline execution in ISO-8601 format.

pipeline_version.description: Semantic version of the full analysis pipeline.

model_version.description: Identifier of the LLM used during this analysis run (e.g., 'gpt-4.1', 'gpt-5.1').

execution_time_ms.description: Total time (in milliseconds) required to execute the full pipeline.

determinism_fingerprint.description: Optional reproducibility signature generated from normalized input and config.
